5
Which statement defines atomic number?
A
It is the total number of protons in the nucleus of an atom.
B
It is the total number of protons and neutrons in the nucleus of an atom.
C
It is the number of different atoms in one molecule.
D
It is the simplest whole number ratio of atoms in a compound.
